executive_summary: A proud visiting scholar challenges King Krishnadeva Raya's court to identify the contents of a silk-wrapped bundle. Tenali Rama accepts the challenge, bringing his own bundle named 'Tilakashtatishthamahisha'. Intimidated by the grand-sounding name, the scholar flees overnight. The next day, Tenali reveals the phrase was merely a Sanskrit pun for sesame sticks (Tila-kashta) and buffalo rope (Mahisha-bandhana).
